children: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent canceled a planned Sunday appearance on the CBS program "Face the Nation." His appearance would have given the Trump administration an opportunity to present a senior official to address voters about the economy days before the midterms.

The Treasury Department didn't tell CBS why Bessent wouldn't appear, according to Jeremy Adler, a senior vice president for communications at CBS News. A Treasury Department spokesman didn't respond to a request for comment.

Bessent has aggressively defended the Trump administration against criticism that its economic agenda has led to higher borrowing costs and rising inflation. Bessent is also leading the economic pressure campaign against Iran. Trump said recently that he was considering renewing military operations against Iran, in what the president called "a little Epic Fury."
